vo_hair_balayage_irregular_ribbons.evidence: At thumbnail scale, numerous warm lighter ribbons of visibly unequal widths are distributed across both the left and right hair masses rather than confined to one patch.

vo_hair_balayage_soft_root_transition.evidence: Thumbnail and native inspection show a distinctly darker crown whose individual strands transition gradually into warm lighter sections without one universal hard root boundary.

vo_hair_balayage_mid_end_distribution.evidence: Across both scales, lighter ribbons begin at staggered distances below the crown and continue with varied density through the visible mid-lengths and lower ends.

vo_hair_balayage_base_continuity.evidence: At native scale, uninterrupted dark brown base strands remain clearly visible between lighter ribbons under the jaw, beside both shoulders, and through the lower hair.

vo_hair_balayage_not_ombre_or_foil.evidence: Native inspection shows no horizontal dip line or full-width lightening; ribbon widths and spacing vary, and warm strand color persists through shaded bends, distinguishing it from regular foil stripes or specular light alone.
